lyrics.original: 하루 비워둬, That’s all it takes
lyrics.romanization: haru biwodwo, that’s all it takes
lyrics.english: Clear your day, That’s all it takes

lyrics.original: Pull up in my coupe, 데리러 갈게
lyrics.romanization: pull up in my coupe, derireo galge
lyrics.english: Pull up in my coupe, I’ll come pick you up

lyrics.original: We don’t need a passport, 떠나 가볍게
lyrics.romanization: we don’t need a passport, tteona gabyeopge
lyrics.english: We don’t need a passport, Let’s leave without a care

lyrics.romanization: It’s a joyride with no GPS

lyrics.original: Airplane mode, 온종일 켜둬 그냥 냅둬 남은 일
lyrics.romanization: airplane mode, onjongil kyeodwo geunyang naepdwo nameun il
lyrics.english: Airplane mode, Leave it on all day, just forget about the work left behind

lyrics.original: Home sweet home 잠시 뒤로 해, 식혀둘래 머리는 Chill
lyrics.romanization: home sweet home jamsi dwiro hae, sikyeodullae meorineun chill
lyrics.english: Put home sweet home aside for a while, Let your head cool down, chill

lyrics.original: 팻말은 뒤집어 Take a day off, 페달을 밟아 Imma drive
lyrics.romanization: paetmareun dwijibeo take a day off, pedareul balba imma drive
lyrics.english: Turn the sign around, take a day off, Step on the pedal, Imma drive

lyrics.original: 또 왼손엔 한 잔의 Cherry coke, 딱 오늘만 쉬어 It’s alright
lyrics.romanization: tto oensoneneun han janui cherry coke, ttak oneulman swieo it’s alright
lyrics.english: And in my left hand, a glass of Cherry Coke, Just take today off, it’s alright

lyrics.romanization: Go for a ride

lyrics.original: 지도에도 없는 Route, 누구나 아는 쉬운 길은, 전부 벗어나
lyrics.romanization: jidoedo eomneun route, nuguna aneun swiun gireun, jeonbu beoseona
lyrics.english: A route that isn’t even on the map, Leave behind, All the easy roads everyone knows

lyrics.original: 낯설은 Avenue, 기꺼이 헤매볼까
lyrics.romanization: natseoreun avenue, gikkeoi hemaebolkka
lyrics.english: An unfamiliar avenue, Shall we willingly get lost?

lyrics.original: Gotta take a five 때론 필요해, 예정에 없던 Siesta
lyrics.romanization: gotta take a five ttaeron piryohae, yejeonge eopdeon siesta
lyrics.english: Gotta take a five, sometimes you need it, An unscheduled siesta

lyrics.original: 우린 자유롭고 나른해, 어쩌면 이게 Driver’s high
lyrics.romanization: urin jayuropgo nareunhae, eojjeomyeon ige driver’s high
lyrics.english: We’re free and lazy, Maybe this is what they call a driver’s high

lyrics.original: Take the road, 여유만 가득 실은 채로
lyrics.romanization: take the road, yeoyuman gadeuk sireun chaero
lyrics.english: Take the road, With nothing but leisure packed inside

lyrics.original: 한 템포 느린 태도, 그게 우리 Dress code
lyrics.romanization: han tempo neurin taedo, geuge uri dress code
lyrics.english: An attitude one tempo slower, That’s our dress code

lyrics.original: We don’t need a way home, 내 직감만을 쫓아가
lyrics.romanization: we don’t need a way home, nae jiggammaneul jjotaga
lyrics.english: We don’t need a way home, I’ll just follow my instincts

lyrics.romanization: dansume jigu wireul, myeot bakwireul doneun gibun
lyrics.english: In an instant, around the Earth, Feels like going around it a few times

lyrics.romanization: Free and crazy, With my crew all in the backseat

lyrics.english: Take take take it way up, Even the destination is random

lyrics.english: Having no plan is my masterplan, Lemme shuffle all my playlist
